text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for region az13 - increased 5xxs and request queueing on serving-pool-az13. PD: PGR-az13-4532. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/az13-deg 

pagerduty: Pager fired -> PGR-az13-4532 (severity: high). Escalation chain initiated.

carla_oncall: I'm on it, acked on PD. Starting triage — is this load spike or infra?

ben_sre: seeing KV cache eviction errors + pacing on gRPC connections in az13. ps: 20% pod OOMs on shard-routing-controller.

alice_eng: metrics -> token latency p50 doubled, p90 x4. Error sample: 503 backend_unavailable, also "kvcache_miss_rate" spiking.

carla_oncall: tagging customers in impacted list, will confirm if any dedicated customers hit SLA. Taylor, can you pull recent alerts for Dedicated accounts in az13?

taylor_support: pulling support filters now. Early look: 3 Dedicated tenants reporting elevated latencies, several hosted API keys seeing 5xx spikes. Sending incident banner to status page draft.

dave_ops: infra view: host-level NIC errors on 3 nodes in az13, fabric retransmits up. Suggest holding scale-up until we verify network stability.

ben_sre: probable root cause: az13 leaf switch partial flap causing intermittent shard connectivity -> leads to K/V cache thrash + request backlog. Fallback options: 1) divert region traffic to az4/us-west; 2) activate canary-serving fallback to smaller model variant (quantized) in az13; 3) evict problematic nodes.

carla_oncall: Action plan: 1) open PD bridge -> done (bridge: https://pd/redwood/bridge/PGR-az13-4532), 2) start targeted traffic divert for non-dedicated traffic to us-west-az4, 3) contact infra to cordon/evacuate NIC-failing hosts. Anyone object? :eyes: 

alice_eng: Initiating divert rule: resourcerouter policy updated to prefer us-west-az4 for region.az==az13 && tier==hosted-api. Command: ```curl -XPOST https://controlplane/route/divert -d '{"from":"az13","to":"az4","filter":"tier=hosted"}'``` Applying now.

incident-bot: Automated check: divert rule applied, 73% of new hosted requests now routing to az4. Monitoring impact on latency and 5xxs.

taylor_support: Posting status update to customers: "We are aware of increased errors affecting some requests in az13. Traffic is being diverted and engineers are actively mitigating. No action needed from customers." Sending now.

ben_sre: infra has cordoned 3 NIC-failure hosts. Evac underway: pods draining. Watch for temporary capacity dip. Autoscaler: will spin up warm instances in az4.

carla_oncall: @ben_sre please run quick sanity on model KV cache rehydrate after drains. We saw partial cache corruption once when eviction racing coincided with node removal.

ben_sre: Running rehydrate and consistency check. Patch applied to throttle eviction aggressiveness: `--kvcache-evict-threshold=0.85` on affected deploys.

incident-bot: PD note: Pager acknowledged by carla_oncall at 1769997783. Escalated to ben_sre at 1769997790.

alice_eng: After divert: hosted 5xxs dropped from 12% -> 1.8% in 4m. Latency trending down; p90 back to 1.6s. Dedicated traffic still showing some errors (~4%).

taylor_support: Dedicated tenant ops: reached out to account owners for the 3 impacted tenants, offering mitigation steps and ETA 30-45m for full recovery.

dave_ops: NIC vendor engaged, fabric team says intermittent ASIC firmware glitch on switch-stack. They recommend full-stack reboot for affected rack; scheduling maintenance window with rollback plan.

carla_oncall: Given current improvement for hosted, we keep divert in place and proceed with controlled reboot of switch-stack after peak hours. We'll keep dedicated tenants on monitoring and route them to fallback variants if errors persist.

ben_sre: Adding automatic fallback policy for dedicated requests: if 5xx_rate > 2% for 5m -> route to compatible model-variant (quantized) in az4. Will deploy rule in 2m.

incident-bot: Fallback rule deployed. 

carla_oncall: PD: Please suppress further auto-escalation for this incident for 60m; we'll re-evaluate. Also creating incident timeline doc.

pagerduty: Alert actions updated: suppression set for 60m for PGR-az13-4532.

alice_eng: Quick note: logs show one edge case where request mux stuck on old connection and timeouts aligned with NIC drop. Added a transient retry at the proxy level to reduce customer visible 5xx. Patch pushed: `proxy_retry=2` for region az13, rollback hotfix available.

taylor_support: Posted update to status page: "Service partially degraded in az13; traffic diverted. Engineering estimates minimal impact to most customers. Live updates on the incident bridge."

carla_oncall: Current status: mitigated for hosted traffic, dedicated still monitored. Next steps: 1) monitor for 30m, 2) schedule hardware reboot with infra, 3) prepare RCA draft for postmortem. If dedicated tenant errors persist after fallback rule, we'll begin customer-specific failover handbacks.

ben_sre: Ongoing checks: KV cache miss rate decreasing, connection resets falling. Will post when we confirm stable for 30m.

dave_ops: Infra schedule: reboot targeted at 1769998200 (in ~6 minutes) with rollback plan. Will coordinate with carla_oncall and ben_sre.

carla_oncall: Acknowledged. Great work team. I'll keep the bridge open and update PD once we hit stable window. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Update: last_message_ts updated to 1769997822.
